bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches or nonclear clutches up to 6 × 9 inches are allowed after search; other bags are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: A garage is directly across from the venue on 29th Street; eligible event tickets may include parking validation until the garage fills.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue arrival guide and accessibility page do not designate a rideshare point; the accessibility page directs passenger drop-offs to the main entrance on Granada Avenue.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The hall has a full bar and West Coast Tavern serves food. Outside food, drinks and alcohol are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The main entrance on Granada Avenue and lobby restrooms are accessible; accessible floor seating is to the right of the stage. Request sign-language interpretation at least two weeks ahead.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Leaving and re-entering the venue is prohibited.

ticketPickup.summary: Pick up Will Call tickets at the box office beginning two hours before doors on show nights; bring photo ID and the purchasing card.

gates.summary: Check the specific show listing for times. The main entrance is accessible and Fast Lane is available as a separately purchased upgrade.
